headline: NPR explains how Trump's crypto ventures built his wealth
pages: Researchers at the Center for American Progress, a left-leaning think tank, estimate President Trump and his family have made nearly $3 billion in his second term, with more than $2 billion from cryptocurrency ventures. Researcher Will Ragland said the sum of earlier presidents' income in office would not come close. Shortly before his 2025 inauguration, Trump and First Lady Melania Trump each launched a meme coin, a cryptocurrency based on an internet joke or character. NPR walks through how the money was made. Democrats, who won both the Senate and House in this month's midterms and take over next year, have promised oversight hearings. Rep.

Robert Garcia of California sent a letter after the election telling Trump, his family and his administration to preserve records. Transparency advocates have raised alarms about the profits. Source: NPR.
